Transitive crates from crates.io are not all Apache-2.0. `deny.toml` at the
workspace root lists the SPDX identifiers accepted for them (MIT, BSD-2-Clause,
BSD-3-Clause, Zlib, ISC, the Unicode licences, MPL-2.0, BSL-1.0, CC0-1.0,
OpenSSL, CDLA-Permissive-2.0) and the per-advisory dispositions.
